title: scenarios: the open ask cards cover the ten question kinds the hosted ask set asks, so an ask regression is caught here first
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「很多测试任务能在开源项目处理的尽量用开源项目」, and earlier: 「而且开源项目应该就可以测试，不需要访问 cloud」. Ruling behind it: D6 = A on #34659 (extend the open cards; borrow the hosted kinds, not the hosted fixture).

## Why

What decides most ask answers is in the framework: matching a word to a metric, compiling the query, counting and grouping, the permission line, the labels. Today the only test set that asks every kind of question sits in the hosted product's repository, needs a hosted environment and its model billing, and has run once. A regression in the framework is therefore found late, on the product, by a run that costs money, when it could be found the same day here for nothing.

Who acts: the devx lane (`docs/qa/scenarios/**`, `packages/qa/scenarios/**`). Reader: the eval seat's daily round (#34869), and the cloud seat, which then runs its own set per release as a confirmation.

## Evidence (read 2026-11-18)

- The hosted ask set holds 56 questions in ten kinds: `count` 4, `group_sum` 5, `top_n` 4, `time_range` 4, `join` 3, `owner_latest` 6, `business_term` 10, `ambiguous` 7, `forbidden` 9, `unanswerable` 4; 41 asked as a manager, 15 as a member.
- The open dataset cards (`order_to_cash`, `travel_expense`, from #34687) each carry 5 dataset questions: two metric, one ambiguous, one near-miss, one fallback. No open card states which of the ten kinds its ordinary questions cover.
- The open runner already grades correct, cited and leaks per persona, and the route graders `metric-selected`, `asked-back`, `fallback-labelled`. The hosted repository already imports the open scorer and has a driver that runs the open cards against its own agent, so one card can be asked two ways.

## Scope

- A table in `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`: the ten kinds, and for each which open card asks it and how many times.
- Questions added until every kind is asked at least twice across the dataset cards, in Chinese and English, including `forbidden` asked as the member persona (the leak reading) and `unanswerable`.
- Generic questions written for the open cards. ⛔ None is copied from the hosted set: its held-out questions stay private so they keep measuring.
- The record of a round reports its counts per kind.

## Done when

- The table shows no kind at zero, and one ask round over the dataset cards reports every kind.

## Out of scope

- The hosted set, its environment and its cadence. Asking through the product's own agent.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687, #34869, #34996.
- Dedup, open and closed: `scenario ask cards question kinds forbidden unanswerable` — see the search this card was filed with; no card found.
